answer_2.quote: We consider the joint goal accuracy (JGA), L2-Error and expected calibration error (ECE).

answer_4.quote: Subjects are recruited through the Amazon Mechanical Turk platform to interact with our systems via the DialCrowd platform.
answer_4.guideline: The subjects rate the system as successful if they think they received all the information required and all constraints were met. The subjects rate each system on a 5 point Likert scale.
